verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's hosted Wally inference API is documented only as OpenAI-compatible, with chat completions at https://inference.runanywhere.ai/v1. Nothing in the evidence shows an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint. A serving API could plausibly offer one, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint
